description:
This episode explores history's most devastating computer hacks, from North Korea's record-breaking Binance cryptocurrency theft to the Stuxnet worm that physically destroyed Iranian nuclear centrifuges. It examines ransomware attacks that crippled American fuel supplies and Costa Rican government systems, culminating with NotPetya, widely considered the most costly cyberattack ever recorded.
